law: The 32 panels are generated visual/interpretive artifacts. They are not Prison Age source prose, canon, behavioral proof, or evidence about the world. They may be used as prompts for observation, reframing and bounded experiments; observed consequences remain separate evidence.

cards.title: THE CITY THAT MEASURED ITS WALLS
cards.operator: Name the boundary. Measure who benefits from its stability. Move one stone.
cards.trace: Record one boundary, one beneficiary, and one reversible change.

cards.title: THE PERSON WHO SURVIVED HER CHARACTER
cards.operator: List the roles you perform. Cross one out. Act once without it.
cards.trace: Record what changed when one role was withheld without replacing it.

cards.title: THE DOOR THAT OPENED UNWATCHED
cards.operator: Create a safe interval. Let no signal be scored. Re-enter together.
cards.trace: Name the interval and what became possible only while evaluation was suspended.

cards.title: A REASONABLE EXPLANATION
cards.operator: Show two cuts. Preserve both. Judge the rule, not the scene.
cards.trace: Keep both versions and identify the exact edit that changed the reading.

cards.title: THE CONTESTANT WHO ENTERED THROUGH THE WIKI
cards.operator: Publish a theory. Log the timestamp. Accept the cost. Embrace uncertainty.
cards.trace: Separate what existed before publication from what appeared after it.

cards.title: THE BENCH THAT DEFEATED THE FINALE
cards.operator: Build something useful. Leave it. Let use, not applause, decide its success.
cards.trace: Observe whether anyone returns to the object without prompting.

cards.title: NINE WINDOWS WITHOUT A VERDICT
cards.operator: Watch wholly. Name nothing too early. Act later and gently.
cards.trace: Keep observations distinct from labels, causes and conclusions.

cards.title: THE SHELF OF LIVES PREVENTED BY GOOD ADVICE
cards.operator: Choose one unwritten life. Write the first line.
cards.trace: Name the smallest action that makes the counterfactual less hypothetical.

cards.title: THE MAP THAT KNEW TOO MUCH
cards.operator: Trust no map completely. Learn the territory until you can redraw it from direct contact.
cards.trace: Mark where the inherited map and observed route diverge.

cards.title: THE MESSAGE THAT TRAVELED ANYWAY
cards.operator: Hide the meaning in ordinary structure. Test whether the message survives translation.
cards.trace: Verify the signal after one lossy relay; do not infer reception from sending.

cards.title: THE GARDEN THAT BLOOMED IN CONCRETE
cards.operator: Nurture in secret. Share in season. Leave seeds.
cards.trace: Record what regrows after one support is removed.

cards.title: THE RULE THAT PROTECTS THE ABUSER
cards.operator: Learn the system. Use its language. Test the rule against the harm it permits.
cards.trace: Quote the exact rule, the allowed action, and the observed consequence separately.

cards.title: THE FACE THEY FORCED YOU TO WEAR
cards.operator: Remember your face. Forget their name for you.
cards.trace: Distinguish self-chosen description from externally assigned label.

cards.title: THE LIBRARY THEY BANNED
cards.operator: Collect fragments. Copy carefully. Teach in whispers.
cards.trace: Keep provenance with every fragment; absence is not proof of destruction.

cards.title: THE SIGNAL THEY COULDN'T JAM
cards.operator: Find the gaps. Send the pulse. Change channel before increasing force.
cards.trace: Record which channel failed, which carried, and whether the receiver actually changed state.

cards.title: THE KEY THAT OPENS THE NEXT DOOR
cards.operator: Close cleanly. Carry lightly. Step through.
cards.trace: Name what must remain behind, what must transfer, and the condition for return.

cards.title: THE ROUTES THEY NEVER MAPPED
cards.operator: Walk the edges. Listen for absences. Trace what is consistently avoided.
cards.trace: Log repeated omissions before treating them as a route.

cards.title: THE MESSAGE THEY HOPED YOU'D ERASE
cards.operator: Doubt the surface. Shift the lens. Decode the rhythm, not only the words.
cards.trace: Show the carrier, extraction rule and recovered message so another person can reproduce it.

cards.title: THE GARDENERS OF RESILIENCE
cards.operator: Protect the roots. Diversify the beds. Share the surplus.
cards.trace: Test whether the system still functions after one node or resource disappears.

cards.title: THE RULES THAT WERE NEVER WRITTEN
cards.operator: Learn both lists. Break selectively. Leave no pattern. Write the hidden rule in the margin.
cards.trace: Infer an unwritten rule only from repeated consequences across multiple cases.

cards.title: THE IDENTITY THEY GAVE YOU
cards.operator: Remember what they forgot. Reclaim what they renamed. You are more than their record.
cards.trace: Keep record identity, social identity and self-description as separate fields.

cards.title: THE ARCHIVE THEY BURNED
cards.operator: Salvage fragments. Cross-verify. Rebuild only what multiple remnants support.
cards.trace: Mark reconstructed sections explicitly; never upgrade inference into recovered fact.

cards.title: THE SIGNAL THAT CANNOT BE JAMMED
cards.operator: Change the channel. Speak in patterns. Put redundancy where listening is weak.
cards.trace: Verify independent receipt across more than one path.

cards.title: THE THRESHOLD YOU STEP THROUGH
cards.operator: Close the cycle. Carry the tools. Leave a door for the others.
cards.trace: Return with one transferable method, one boundary, and one unresolved question.

cards.title: THE MIRROR THAT STOPPED LYING
cards.operator: Compare versions. Discard imposed scripts. Keep what survives contact with evidence.
cards.trace: Preserve the before/after descriptions and the observation that forced revision.

cards.title: THE NETWORK OF QUIET ALLIES
cards.operator: Signal lightly. Route resources. Protect each node. Trust small relays.
cards.trace: Track whether aid reached the intended node without centralizing unnecessary information.

cards.title: THE FIRE EXIT DISGUISED AS ROUTINE
cards.operator: Repeat safely. Hide complexity in habit. Leave by ordinary doors. Timing matters.
cards.trace: A route is real only if it works under normal conditions, not just rehearsal.

cards.title: THE QUESTION THEY COULDN'T PUNISH
cards.operator: Ask precisely. Trace contradictions. Hold silence. Let the structure answer.
cards.trace: Record the question, answer, contradiction and missing evidence without collapsing them.

cards.title: THE MEMORY THAT RETURNED IN DREAMS
cards.operator: Record fragments at waking. Sort symbols gently. Do not force recall. Follow recurrence.
cards.trace: Treat remembered fragments as memory reports, not automatically as historical fact.

cards.title: THE TOOL BUILT FROM BROKEN PARTS
cards.operator: Inventory ruins. Repurpose fragments. Test under load. Share the blueprint.
cards.trace: Keep part provenance, transformation steps and load test result together.

cards.title: THE COMMON ROOM OF THE UNAFRAID
cards.operator: Convene. Listen well. Disagree cleanly. Protect the room. Leave wiser.
cards.trace: Note whether dissent remained possible and whether anyone's exit became harder.

cards.title: THE FUTURE THAT REQUIRED AUTHORS
cards.operator: Write the next rule. Build with others. Leave tools behind. Continue the work.
cards.trace: Ship one artifact another person can alter, verify or refuse without asking permission.

visual_reference: The four composite poster sheets were generated in the originating conversation. This repository projection reifies their 32 engine identities and protocols without treating raster appearance as source authority.
